corrections.detail: On Sept. 25, 2026, we moved the deadline on 8 Wall Street analyst cards by two or three days. A 12-month stock call is checked 12 months after the date shown on the card, New York time. If that day falls on a weekend or a day the U.S. stock market is closed, the deadline moves to the next trading day. These 8 cards had deadlines on a Saturday or on New Year's Day, when the market is closed. They now end on the following Monday. Vivek Arya (BofA), AMD: "Arya (BofA): Buy; raises AMD PT to $300 from $250 on Helios/OCP." and "Arya (BofA): Buy on AMD." Deadline moved from Oct. 17, 2026 to Oct. 19, 2026. Vivek Arya (BofA), Nvidia: "Arya (BofA): Buy; maintains $350 Nvidia PT; top sector pick." and "Arya (BofA): Buy on Nvidia (top sector pick)." Deadline moved from June 5, 2027 to June 7, 2027. Srini Pajjuri (RBC), Micron: a price-target card dated Sept. 18, 2026. Deadline moved from Sept. 18, 2027 to Sept. 20, 2027. Christopher Rolland (Susquehanna), ON Semiconductor: "Rolland (Susquehanna): Buy; Street-high $150 ON Semiconductor PT (~120% upside)." Deadline moved from Sept. 18, 2027 to Sept. 20, 2027. Timothy Arcuri (UBS), Lam Research: "Arcuri (UBS): Buy; raises Lam Research PT to $200 from $175." and "Arcuri (UBS): reiterates Buy on Lam Research." Deadline moved from Jan. 1, 2027 to Jan. 4, 2027. No grades changed. The five price-target cards were still Pending and the three rating cards were still Unscorable at the time. No card's deadline has passed. The source and date said are unchanged on every card. Later the same day we also removed the word "Buy" from the wording of two of these cards (Srini Pajjuri on Micron and Christopher Rolland on ON Semiconductor); see the separate entry. On Oct. 2, 2026, we removed Srini Pajjuri's Micron price-target card because its source can't be used under our source rules (see the separate entry). This affects only these cards and the profiles of the four analysts named.

On Sept. 25, 2026, we edited the claim text on 8 analyst price-target cards to remove the word "Buy". Our rules require an analyst's rating to appear in the broker's own published wording. These cards carried a generic "Buy" taken from a third-party summary, so we removed that word. The cards were: (1) Harlan Sur (JPMorgan), Nvidia, dated Aug. 28, 2025; (2) Harlan Sur (JPMorgan), Nvidia, dated Aug. 27, 2026; (3) Srini Pajjuri (RBC), Nvidia, dated Aug. 27, 2026; (4) Stacy Rasgon (Bernstein), Nvidia, dated Sept. 21, 2026; (5) Stacy Rasgon (Bernstein), Broadcom, dated Sept. 21, 2026; (6) Stacy Rasgon (Bernstein), Broadcom, dated Sept. 14, 2026; (7) Srini Pajjuri (RBC), Micron, dated Sept. 18, 2026; and (8) Christopher Rolland (Susquehanna), ON Semiconductor, dated Sept. 18, 2026, which changed from "Rolland (Susquehanna): Buy; Street-high $150 ON Semiconductor PT (~120% upside)." to "Rolland (Susquehanna): Street-high $150 ON Semiconductor PT (~120% upside)." This edit did not change the price target, deadline or grade on any card, and all 8 were still Pending at the time. Two of these cards (Srini Pajjuri on Micron and Christopher Rolland on ON Semiconductor) also had their deadlines moved to the next trading day earlier today, as described in a separate entry. On Oct. 2, 2026, we removed cards (1) to (7) because their source can't be used under our source rules (see the separate entries). The same calls as cards (1) and (2) stay on Harlan Sur's profile as new cards from a different source. Card (8) stays on the site and is still Pending. This affects only these cards and the profiles of the four analysts named.

retractions.detail: We removed a rating card for Harlan Sur (JPMorgan) on Nvidia: "Sur (JPMorgan): Buy on Nvidia." (dated Aug. 28, 2025). Our rules now require an analyst's rating to be recorded in the broker's own published wording. This card was based on a third-party summary that described the rating as a generic "Buy", so it no longer meets that rule. Readers will no longer see this card on Harlan Sur's profile, on the Claims page or in search, and Harlan Sur's Unscorable count goes down by one. The card was Unscorable, so no grade or score changed. Harlan Sur's related price-target card from that day stayed on the site at the time and was still Pending. Later the same day we removed the word "Buy" from that card's wording, and on Oct. 2, 2026, we removed that card because its source can't be used under our source rules (see the separate entries). The same price-target call stays on his profile as a new card from a different source.
